provider_versions.actual_reading: Complete FMP1–FMP13; original full-state conditional maps, global endpoint rigidity, crossing face, reflection and full trace-complement domains.
HCB1 original Hessian minimum principle and exact four-link potential Hessian, reused without changing any original metric or coupling.
RHB1–RHB3 original closed-geodesic gradient and full-dimensional Hessian estimates, applied here to the actual trace marginal with an explicit continuous-isometry averaging calculation.

owner_review.coverage: Complete QLR1–QLR10: original Haar coordinates and smooth cutoff closure defect; explicit nine-by-nine endpoint map, determinant, all factor derivatives, contraction radius and numerical word bound; quantitative loop and two-face oscillation; actual marginal Hessian; exact complete Wilson crossing Fourier coefficient; original global density and Haar-ball norm floor; full complementary energy and Jensen memory bounds.
owner_review.strengthening: FMP12–FMP13 positivity is strengthened to an evaluated positive lower bound at every original regulator, with every constant fixed. The endpoint group-generation argument is made quantitative by the complete original matrix.
owner_review.corrections: No published error found. QLR1–QLR2 exhibit the exact failure of unrestricted L2 coercivity, which FMP11 did not claim. The actual proof uses established derivative bounds. The cutoff is not claimed gauge invariant.
owner_review.limitations: The bound has severe full-volume and density losses; its displayed evaluations do not prove uniform shrinking-window mass, the signed three-shift combination or continuum reconstruction.
